name: Rubyfront of the Abyss
summary: Attrition control: filter the deck, weaken the opposing Front and devour its smaller Entities.

unionRequirement.label: Union requirement
unionRequirement.text: Retire to Requiem a Human you attributed a Zero Matter to

faceA.name: Rubyfront of the Abyss

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · on failure −3 HP

effect.name: Undertow
effect.text: Look at the top card of your deck: you may leave it there or put it on the bottom of your deck.

pressure.name: Abyssal Pressure
pressure.text: an opposing Entity of your choice gets −2 Power until the start of your next turn.

devour.name: Devour
devour.text: put an opposing Entity with Power 3 or less on the bottom of its owner’s deck.

faceA.flavor: It did not rise. The abyss opened its eyes.

faceB.name: The Abyss Incarnate

effect.name: The First Wave
effect.text: Tap an opposing Entity of your choice. (A tapped Entity can neither attack nor block until it untaps.)

tide.name: Rising Tide
tide.text: up to two opposing Entities of your choice get −2 Power until the start of your next turn.

abyss.name: The Great Tide
abyss.text: tap every opposing Entity on the field. (Use it before declaring your attack: a tapped Entity cannot block.)

faceB.flavor: The abyss no longer waits below. It walks.
